harness: Unmodified upstream benchmark workload functions run directly. The pyperf CLI and calibration wrapper are omitted; a tiny adapter supplies the timing function, and fresh-process timings include adapter/import overhead. This is a reproducible source probe, not an official pyperf result.

richards.veritas_result: not yet ported; no Veritas timing or parity claim

nbody.note: Veritas is a source translation with equivalent initial conditions and energy output, not the unmodified pyperformance program. Timing includes Veritas source parsing/typechecking/compilation and Python module import.

limitations: Only one host and one Python build were measured.
This does not execute the pyperf calibration/reporting harness.
Richards has only a Python source baseline; the Veritas implementation remains open.
The official benchmark suite is diagnostic evidence, not the real-task recommendation gate.
